code-bounded-map.name: 隐藏异步结果测试
code-bounded-map.code:
import asyncio
async def worker(x): return x + 1
assert asyncio.run(bounded_map([1, 3], worker, 1)) == [2, 4]

py-code-04-traced.name: 隐藏关键字参数测试
py-code-04-traced.code:
@traced
def f(*, value): return value
assert f(value=3) == 3
assert hasattr(f, '__wrapped__')

py-code-05-positive.name: 隐藏多字段测试
py-code-05-positive.code:
class Box:
    width = Positive()
    height = Positive()
b = Box(); b.width = 2; b.height = 3
assert (b.width, b.height) == (2, 3)
